spec.description:
Autex Acoustic Timber Panel is a high-performance acoustic treatment designed
to realistically imitate timber. Formed from thermally bonded high-density
polyester using a 25mm Quietspace Panel base, it features woodgrain textures
taken from real timber veneers digitally printed onto the panel surface with
safe, water-based UV-cured ink. It delivers an authentic timber aesthetic while
meeting strict seismic requirements and Group 1 fire compliance across wall and
ceiling applications.
features:

from real timber veneers

Lightweight and seismic compliant alternative to solid timber panelling

install:
Inspect panels prior to install and verify grain orientation and
lot consistency

Ensure the wall or ceiling substrate is flat, clean, dry, and
dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the installation environment for at least 24
hours

Cut through the face of the panel using a straight edge and sharp
utility knife

Place straight edge on excess section to avoid rubbing or
friction on the decorative face

Apply recommended contact or construction
adhesive evenly across the panel backing

Position panel onto the substrate
and butt-join sheets tightly along vertical joins

Apply firm, uniform
pressure with a roller across the panel to ensure full bond contact
selection_checklist:
Confirm woodgrain finish from available timber grains
(e.g. Birch, Oak, Hoop Pine, Ash, Eucalyptus)

Verify substrate flatness and
suitability for direct-fix adhesive mounting

Confirm thickness and acoustic
performance target (25mm Quietspace base delivers NRC 0.85)

Check that panel
will be located in non-contact areas to prevent surface scuffing

Confirm
ceiling and wall dimensions to determine standard 2400mm vs 2700mm lengths
accessories: Autex Edging Solutions (Type C profile for 25mm panels)
limitations:
Recommended for non-contact areas as printed surface may show
scuff marks under impact

Do not use in high-impact sports halls without
protective screening

Variations in grain pattern are intentional to replicate
natural timber veneer
Indoor use only; avoid direct prolonged water exposure

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Acoustic Timber - Quietspace is a 25mm thick,
high-performance acoustic wall and ceiling panel that realistically replicates
natural timber grain. Constructed from thermally bonded 100% polyester fibres on
a dual-density Quietspace Panel base, high-resolution woodgrains are digitally
printed using safe, water-based UV-cured ink without reducing acoustic
absorption. Delivering an outstanding NRC of 0.85, Group 1 fire classification,
and carbon-neutral certification, it replaces heavy, resonant timber panelling
with a lightweight, seismic-compliant solution that eliminates interior
reverberation.
